issue.title: Skill tests still require deleted sase_hg_commit source
issue.description:
## CI failure

- **Node:** `tests/main/test_init_skills_sources.py::test_docs_xprompt_bundled_skills_table_matches_packaged_sources`

HEAD `6e99c7fc6` (`chore: Remove /sase_hg_commit`) deleted `src/sase/xprompts/skills/sase_hg_commit.md` but left the packaged-skill tests and the bundled-skills table in `docs/xprompt.md` still enumerating it. This is leftover from that removal, not from monitor-starter runtime work.

Same-tree rerun is identically red (2 failed in 1.53s). The table assertion diffs `sase_hg_commit` at index 6; the content tests raise `FileNotFoundError` for the deleted source.

Sister nodes from the same gap:

- `tests/main/test_init_skills_source_content.py::test_commit_skill_sources_do_not_reference_legacy_bead_flag[sase_hg_commit]`
- `tests/main/test_init_skills_source_content.py::test_commit_skill_sources_reject_legacy_sase_commit_cli[sase_hg_commit]`
- `tests/main/test_init_skills_source_content.py::test_hg_commit_skill_invokes_stitch_create`

Scope: drop `sase_hg_commit` from the docs table and from the skill-source tests. Related but not a duplicate: ready task `sase-pf` is earlier table drift (omitted rows), not this deleted-source leftover.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: HEAD 6e99c7fc6 deleted src/sase/xprompts/skills/sase_hg_commit.md; the tests read that path and the docs table still lists it. Same-tree pytest rerun is identically FileNotFoundError / table-diff red, so this is a standing source-tree mismatch, not intermittency.

payload.description: sase-pf is earlier docs/xprompt.md bundled-skills table drift; this CI bead is leftover sase_hg_commit rows after the skill source was deleted

evidence.note: Independent reproduction on 2026-08-23 while splitting _agent_list_render_agent.py. just check's scoped lane escalated (core-identity-changed from just install rebuilding sase_core_rs) and failed the same leftover sase_hg_commit nodes: test_docs_xprompt_bundled_skills_table_matches_packaged_sources (table still lists sase_hg_commit at index 6) plus the three test_init_skills_source_content.py FileNotFoundError params for the deleted skill source. Working tree only touches agent-list row render modules; this is the same deleted-source leftover, not render work.
